concerns.text: FR-005 requires a Wilcoxon signed‑rank test on per‑repository aggregated Parameter Coverage scores, but no task implements this test (T015 runs Wilcoxon on Composite Scores instead).
FR-07 mandates an exponential backoff retry mechanism for PyPI API calls; no task mentions implementing backoff logic.
FR-008 requires automatically flagging any record whose coverage score falls below 0.2; T009 only flags empty/whitespace docstrings and does not implement the < 0.2 threshold flagging.
FR-009 requires emitting a warning when total paired records are < 30; no task addresses this warning.
FR-013 calls for documenting the circularity limitation (signature copying) in the analysis report; no task is dedicated to adding this documentation.

FR-015 states that methods with `human_docstring` = null must receive a coverage score of 0.0 and be included in per‑repository aggregates; tasks do not explicitly handle inclusion of null‑human records in aggregates.
FR-017 requires a human‑evaluation sampling study; there is no task that runs or records this study.
SC-001 (and SC-005) require verifying that ≥ 80 % of methods achieve Description Coverage ≥ 5 tokens; no task checks or asserts this threshold.
SC-006 demands a Wilcoxon test on per‑repository aggregated scores; this is not covered by any task.
SC-007 requires the human‑evaluation average rating to be ≥ 4.0; no task computes or validates this metric.
The data model defines a Baseline Copy Batch (`baseline_batch_{repo_slug}.json`), but no task creates this artifact.
The data model defines `human_eval_results.json`, yet no task generates this file.
The quickstart guide must be created/updated (T017) and the updated file must exist (T040), but T040 remains unchecked, leaving the guide potentially missing.
Tasks T009 and T011 refer to a field named `coverage_score`, whereas the schema and spec require `parameter_coverage_score`; this naming mismatch will cause schema validation failures.
